content: How much in-force annual premium has Lakefront Brokerage Partners produced?

name: query_salesforce

content: [Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cmAAA/view) has produced **$1,138,520** in annual premium across **52 policies** in force (Active or Pending Renewal). That's about **63%** of the org's $1,815,778 in-force premium.
